ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows a vertical addition. There are three rows of addends: on the right side of the first row is a square, on the right side of the second row is also a square, and the third row is a two-digit number made up of two circles; the result below the horizontal line underneath is a three-digit number made up of three triangles. The plus sign is on the left side, indicating that these three rows are added. Reasoning: Let the square represent the digit s, the circle represent the digit c, and the triangle represent the digit t. According to the vertical form, it can be written as s + s + 11c = 111t, that is, 2s + 11c = 111t. The maximum of the left side is 9 + 9 + 99 = 117, so the three-digit repeated digit on the right side can only be 111, so t = 1. Thus 2s + 11c = 111. Taking modulo 11, we get 2s ≡ 1 (mod 11). Among the digits from 0 to 9, only s = 6 satisfies 2×6 = 12 ≡ 1 (mod 11). Therefore the digit corresponding to the square is 6.

method.method_draft: Read the image as a vertical addition with three addends: a one-digit square, another one-digit square, and a two-digit number made of two circles, giving a three-digit number made of three triangles. Let square = s, circle = c, triangle = t. From the layout, form the place-value equation s + s + 11c = 111t. Since the largest possible left side is 9 + 9 + 99 = 117 and the result is a nonzero three-digit repeated digit, t must be 1. Then 2s + 11c = 111. Reducing modulo 11 gives 2s ≡ 1 mod 11, so s = 6 as the only digit solution.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个竖式加法。加数共有三行：第一行右侧是一个正方形，第二行右侧也是一个正方形，第三行是两个圆形组成的两位数；下方横线下面的结果是三个三角形组成的三位数。加号在左侧，表示这三行相加。

推理：设正方形代表数字 s，圆形代表数字 c，三角形代表数字 t。根据竖式，可写成 s + s + 11c = 111t，即 2s + 11c = 111t。左边最大为 9 + 9 + 99 = 117，因此右边的三位重复数字只能是 111，所以 t = 1。于是 2s + 11c = 111。对 11 取模，得到 2s ≡ 1 (mod 11)。在 0 到 9 的数字中，只有 s = 6 满足 2×6 = 12 ≡ 1 (mod 11)。因此正方形对应的数字是 6。

method.method_draft: Read the image column by column: two square digits and the units circle are added in the units column; the tens circle plus any carry is added in the tens column; the result is three identical triangle digits. Let square = s, circle = c, triangle = t. In the hundreds column, the only source is the carry from the tens column, so that carry equals t. Because the result is three digits, this carry is 1, so t = 1. In the tens column, c plus the units carry must produce digit 1 and carry 1, so c + carry_units = 11. Since c is at most 9, the units carry must be 2 and c = 9. In the units column, s + s + 9 gives digit 1 with carry 2, so 2s + 9 = 21, hence s = 6.
